sam: quick sync after last night's outage. we burned ~38% of the hosted p99 error budget in one maintenance window. need short-term SLO adjustments + concrete action owners for remediation. who can pick this up?
toni: i'll own the SLO change proposal. thinking a short-lived relaxation: p99 180ms -> 240ms for 10 days while infra fixes land. will include clear rollback gates.
sam: please include exact queries + alert thresholds so product sees it, not just engineering.
leo: i'll take remediation list + timelines. first item: KV-cache probe and probe-driven cache warmers (owner: leo, ETA: 2026-04-06). second: conservative batching tuning for mixed-length prompts (owner: toni, ETA: 2026-04-08). third: quick patch to quantized path that avoids pathological allocation (owner: infra-oncall, ETA: 2026-04-05).
toni: for rollback gates i propose: (a) sustained p99 <= 200ms for 48h in canary, (b) error budget burn rate back under 5%/week for 1 week, (c) no regression signals in synthetic probe for 72h. owners for each gate: canary-measurements -> leo, error-budget -> sam, synthetic -> toni.
sam: good. add a dashboard note and annotate the incident tag so historical trend queries can filter similar events.
grafana-bot: annotation created on dashboard 'hosted-p99' at 2026-03-29T02:15:00Z by sam: "postmortem follow-up - SLO rebaseline proposal"
ops-bot: followups created for incident 2026-03-29-1234: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1234
leo: quick ask 1: can we add a saved dashboard filter for 'kv-cache-miss signature' so we can query all incidents matching this pattern? helps detect recurrence.
toni: yes, i'll add saved filter + a lightweight synthetic that hits long/short prompt mix and records 95/99.
sam: timeline: toni SLO doc by 4/1 EOD, leo remediation checklist + probes by 4/3, infra patch by 4/2. schedule a 4/4 check-in after canary results.
leo: noted, making tickets now and will post links here.
toni: also adding a temporary internal note on the customer-facing SLO page explaining the temporary change and expected rollback cadence. will cc legal if needed.
sam: thanks all. once tickets are created, i'll assign owners in the action tracker and close the loop.
